content: Isra7eele Heenththanchchata
GODAA qaalay taakko yiidi,

«Haysso asa nawu! Isra7eele heenththanchchata bolla tinbite yoota; tinbite yootashe, ‹Ubbaa Haariza GODAY, bana xalla xeelliza Isra7eele heenththanchchatas aayye ana! Heenththanchchati wudeza heemmanaas bessennee?
Intte maaththaa uyeeta; iza iskefe dadettida suufeza may7eeta; modhdhidayta shukki meeta shin wudeza xeelleketa.
Daaburdayta minththeththibeeketa; hargidayta dhallibeekketa; meqqidayta koolibeekketa; toylattidayta zaaribeekketa; dhaydayta koyibeekketa. Intte istta geneninne menxe iitateththan haarideta.
Wudeti heenththanchchay baynda gishshas laalettida; laalettidayti wora do7atas quma gidida.
Ta wudeti zumata bollanne zumbullata ubbaa bolla toylattida. Biitta gade gakkanaas laalettida; gido attiin istta xomosiday woykko koyiday deenna› ga.
«Hessa gishshas intteno, heenththanchchatoo, GODAA qaala siyite!

Ubbaa Haariza GODAY, ‹Tani de7o Xoos gididayssan caaqqays!› gees; ta heenththanchchati ta wudeza koyontta gishshassinne ta wudezappe aaththidi banttana xeelliza gishshas ta wudey heenththanchchay dhayiin bonqqettidessinne do7a ubbaas quma gidides.
Hessa gishshas heenththanchchatoo, GODAA qaala siyite!

Ubbaa Haariza GODAY, ‹Tani ta heenththanchchata bolla dendadis; ta wudeta gishshas ta istta oychchana; hayssafe guye heenththanchchati banttana xeellontta malanne ta wudeza heemmontta mala ooththana; istta doonappe tani ta wudeza yegisana. Hayssafe guye isttas quma gidettenna› gees.
Lo7o Heenththanchcha
«Ubbaa Haariza GODAY, ‹Tani tarkka ta wudeta koyana; ta istta naagana.
Heenththanchchay ba wudetara dishe laalettida wudeta koyza mala tanikka ta wudeta koyana; shaara gallassinne dhuma gallas istti laalettidaso ubbaafe ta istta shiishshana.

Kawoteththata giddofe ta istta kessana; derey dizasoppe ta istta shiishshana; ta istta istta biitta zaara ehana; Isra7eele zumata bolla, shaafata lanqeninne biittay bolla duussaso ubbaan ta istta heemmana.
Tani istta lo7o qooron heemmana; dhoqqa Isra7eele zumati istti heemettizasoho gidana; lo7o qooroy diza maatan istti ichchana; heen Isra7eele zumata bolla cililason istti heemettana.
Tani tarkka ta wudeta heemmananne shempisana.
Tani dhaydayssa koyana; toylattidayssaka zaarana; meqqidayssa koolana; daaburdayssaka minththeththana. Gido attiin tani modhdhidaytanne minnidayta dhayssana; wudeza wogara heemmana.
« ‹Ubbaa Haariza GODAY: intte iza wude gidida gishshas, izi intte gishshas iita giddoninne lo7o giddon, dharsho giddoninne orge giddon ta pirdana.
Cilila qooron intte heemettizayssi inttes gidennee? Mishin attida maata intte yedhettana bessizee? Intte xillo haath uyizayssi inttes gidennee? Attidayssa intte intte tohon bulqosanaas bessizee?
Ta wudeti intte intte tohon yedhettida maata maanaassinne intte intte tohon bulqosida haaththaa uyanaas bessizee?› gees.
«Hessa gishshas Ubbaa Haariza GODAY isttas, ‹Be7ite, tani tarkka modhdho mehetassinne gilqa mehetas giddon pirdana.
Laafata intte intte hasheninne intte bunqashen sugiza gishshas, istti goodetti baana gakkanaas intte intte kacen icciza gishshas,
tani ta wudeza ashshana; hayssafe guye istta bonqqettettenna; lo7o meheta giddoninne iita meheta giddon ta pirdana.
Ta istta bollan issi heenththanchcha ta aylle Dawite woththana; izi istta heemmananne isttas heenththanchcha gidana.
Tani GODAY istta Xoos gidana; ta aylle Dawiti istta giddon haarizaade gidana; tani GODAY hayssa yootadis.
« ‹Tani isttara saroteththa caaqo qaala gelana; hessafe guye tani istta wora do7atappe shempisana; isttika bazzo biittan saron de7ana; wora giddonkka woppan ichchana.
Istta yuushoninne ta zumbullata yuushon dizasohota ta anjjana. Woden woden ta isttas ira immana; izikka isttas anjjo ira gidana.

Gaden diza miththati ayfe immana; biittayka kath moyzana; as ubbay ba biitta bolla saron daana. Ta istta qambara menththada istta aylleteththan haaridayta kusheppe wozziza wode tani GODAA gididayssa istti erana.
Hessafe guye hara kawoteththati istta bonqqettenna; wora do7atikka istta puuzettenna; istti saron daana; istta babisana miishshi deenna
Hessafe guye istti koshattontta mala, kawoteththata cashshe tookkontta mala ayfe imon erettida aradda biitta ta isttas immana.
Tani GODAY istta Xoossay isttara dizayssanne Isra7eele keeththi ta dere gididayssa he wode istti erana.
Intte ta wudeti ta heemmiza ta wudeta; intte ta asa; tanikka intte Xoossa; tani Ubbaa Haariza GODAY hayssa yootadis› gees» gides.
